name: Navy Submarine Academy
zh: 中国人民解放军海军潜艇学院

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Navy Submarine Academy in Qingdao, founded in 1953 as the Fourth Naval School and given its present name in 1983, as the PLA Navy’s school for submarine officers, NCOs and enlisted specialists. It has a submarine simulation training centre and a submariner training base, and its departments and specialties include operations command, strategic missiles and underwater weapons, submarine strategic missile command and submarine mine command.
The academy reports to PLA Navy headquarters.
